conclusion: The official localized base rulebook supplies a specific objective-scoring explanation that resolves the original compendium ambiguity in favor of the summary: the 7-VP reputation objective requires the Max reputation level (level 7 in standard play), without an additional wheel-position condition.
scope: Only the reputation-objective clarification is imported. All flow, setup, market, timing, and other rules continue to be governed by the Universal Rules Compendium plus Corrigendum 1.0.

sources.authority: Official French localized base rulebook distributed by Super Meeple; PDF p.1 credits Dan Hallagan and Kayenta Games.

evidence.section: Décompte des points final / 3. PV des cartes Objectif
evidence.exact_relevant_phrase: Il a atteint le niveau de réputation maximum
evidence.translation: He has reached the maximum reputation level.
evidence.assessment: The explanation concerns the reputation objective itself, not ordinary reputation VP. It identifies attainment by the Max counter bearing the British flag on the player board and awards 19 VP for this completed objective plus the 12-VP Domestic Group objective. It mentions no wheel position.

Directly inspected the embedded PDF image. It shows the English 7-VP Reputation Bonus card bearing the Max counter and the wording Maximum reputation required, beside the 12-VP Domestic Group and the unfulfilled 6-VP three-ladys-maids card. Thus this explanation addresses the same card reproduced in compendium p.111, rather than a replacement objective with different wording.
Explicitly states that the Max counter with the flag corresponds to 7 in standard play and 9 in extended play. This supplies the standard-game level mapping for the objective explanation.

The same objective remains Base-labelled, 7 VP, with the same Max-counter illustration and maximum-reputation wording. Neither this entry nor the supplied corrigendum announces a change to this objective.

The 7.5 maximum still applies to the reputation resource cap. The additional objective-specific publisher explanation distinguishes completing the Max-level objective from reaching the last possible wheel position.

edition_compatibility.explicit_edition_label: The supplied French cover text does not explicitly identify itself as second edition; the PDF metadata date alone does not establish an edition.
support: French p.2 lists 30 objectives, 30 VP cards, 95 gentry (2 Fairchilds, 17 family, 15 starter, 35 casual, 26 prestige), four families, 39 base servants, and 80 tiles (15 Essentials, 15 Service, 17 Estate, 15 Prestige, 16 Sporting, 2 hybrids). These agree with compendium p.3 base components.
French p.12 explicitly identifies the hybrids as additions from the second printing and describes the Green Room and the Queen/Lionheart suites present in the audited second-edition base components.
Most decisively, the relevant objective card artwork, wording, Max-counter symbol and 7-VP reward match the later compendium p.111; the companion Domestic Group is also the unchanged 12-VP base card.
edition_compatibility.limits: This supports interpreting the unchanged base objective. It does not authorize importing older general rules or assuming every localized rule predating the compendium remains current.

reasoning: The original report correctly recorded what could not be resolved using the compendium and corrigendum alone. This supplemental publisher source goes beyond the ambiguous card caption: its worked objective example expressly calls the achievement a maximum reputation level and says the Max counter identifies it. Because that is the same unchanged 7-VP base card, and the standard Max counter is expressly level 7, the summary’s level-only interpretation is now supported. A wheel-position requirement would add a condition absent from that objective-specific worked explanation.
recommended_action: Close OBS-SOURCE-01 as resolved by supplemental authoritative evidence. Retain the summary’s current reputation-objective rule and cite the official French base rulebook p.14, with p.7 for the standard Max-level mapping. Keep the original audit as the record of the initial source-only review.
remaining_uncertainty: No material unresolved uncertainty remains for this objective under the combined supplied official sources. Edition naming is inferred from matching components and the exact card, rather than an explicit second-edition cover statement.
independence: Read no question sets, answer keys, reader answers, grades, or other QA outputs. Preserved the original source-audit.json and summary unchanged.
